vet_intake_search_hint.hr: Pretraži po životinji, vlasniku ili napomeni…

vet_intake_no_results.en: No records match this search. Try another term.
vet_intake_no_results.hr: Nema kartona za ovu pretragu. Pokušajte drugi pojam.

vet_response_field_hint.en: Enter your report or instructions here…

vet_conversations_empty.en: No messages sent yet. Write the first report on the Record tab.
vet_conversations_empty.hr: Još nema poslanih poruka. Napišite prvi nalaz na kartici Karton.

vet_conversations_important_empty.en: No important messages marked. Tap the star on a message.
vet_conversations_important_empty.hr: Nema označenih važnih poruka. Dodirnite zvjezdicu uz poruku.

add_product_stock_hint.hr: Unesite okvirnu količinu koju imate na skladištu

add_product_stock_invalid.en: Enter a valid quantity (0 or more)

registration_success.en: Registration successful! Welcome to My Farmer.
registration_success.hr: Registracija uspješna! Dobrodošli u My Farmer.

vet_field_report_empty.en: No field reports yet. Tap + to record a farm visit with notes and a photo.
vet_field_report_empty.hr: Još nema terenskih nalaza. Dodirnite + kako biste zabilježili posjet farmi, bilješke i fotografiju.

company_catalog_csv_bad_headers.en: Invalid file format. Missing required columns: {columns}. Expected: barkod, naziv, cijena, zaliha, jedinica.
company_catalog_csv_bad_headers.hr: Krivi format datoteke. Nedostaju obavezni stupci: {columns}. Očekivano: barkod, naziv, cijena, zaliha, jedinica.

company_catalog_csv_parse_failed.en: Could not read the file as CSV.
company_catalog_csv_parse_failed.hr: Datoteku nije moguće pročitati kao CSV.

company_catalog_csv_row_price_error.en: Error in row {row}: Price must be a number.
company_catalog_csv_row_price_error.hr: Greška u redu {row}: Cijena mora biti broj.

company_catalog_csv_row_stock_error.en: Error in row {row}: Stock must be a number.
company_catalog_csv_row_stock_error.hr: Greška u redu {row}: Zaliha mora biti broj.

company_catalog_csv_row_sku_empty.en: Error in row {row}: SKU is required.
company_catalog_csv_row_sku_empty.hr: Greška u redu {row}: SKU je obavezan.

company_catalog_csv_row_name_empty.en: Error in row {row}: Name is required.
company_catalog_csv_row_name_empty.hr: Greška u redu {row}: Naziv je obavezan.

company_catalog_template_downloaded.en: Template ready — choose where to save it
company_catalog_template_downloaded.hr: Predložak spreman — odaberite gdje ga spremiti

cart_upcoming_card_required.en: Coming-soon products require card payment to secure your reservation.
cart_upcoming_card_required.hr: Za proizvode u dolasku obvezno je plaćanje karticom radi osiguranja rezervacije.

product_upcoming_pro_only.en: "Coming soon" is only available to professional farmers with an active Premium subscription.
product_upcoming_pro_only.hr: Opcija "U dolasku" dostupna je samo profesionalnim farmerima s aktivnom Premium pretplatom.

product_upcoming_card_payment_hint.en: Reservations must be paid by card (Stripe) only.

payment_simulation_confirm_body.en: Simulation mode: confirm digital payment to complete the order.
payment_simulation_confirm_body.hr: Simulacijski način: potvrdite digitalnu uplatu za završetak narudžbe.

payment_google_pay_simulation_body.en:

admin_report_dismissed.en: Report dismissed — post restored to the community.
admin_report_dismissed.hr: Prijava uklonjena — objava je vraćena u zajednicu.

admin_report_delete_body.en: The post will be permanently deleted and the author will be blocked from posting in the community.
admin_report_delete_body.hr: Objava će biti trajno obrisana, a autor neće moći dalje objavljivati u zajednici.

product_no_paypal.en: Farmer has not set up PayPal — cash only.
product_no_paypal.hr: Farmer nije postavio PayPal — plaćanje samo gotovinom.

location_install_body.en: My Farmer uses GPS to show prices and currency for the country you are in. Without location, someone in the EU could not use African prices — and vice versa.
location_install_body.hr: My Farmer koristi GPS kako bi prikazao cijene i valutu prema zemlji u kojoj se nalazite. Bez lokacije netko u EU ne bi smio koristiti afričke cijene — i obrnuto.

location_install_services_off.en: Location services are off. Enable GPS in your phone settings.
location_install_services_off.hr: Usluge lokacije su isključene. Uključite GPS u postavkama telefona.

location_install_permission_denied.en: Location permission denied. Enable it to continue.
location_install_permission_denied.hr: Dozvola za lokaciju je odbijena. Omogućite je da biste nastavili.

location_install_gps_failed.en: We could not verify your location. Try again outdoors.
location_install_gps_failed.hr: Nismo mogli potvrditi vašu lokaciju. Pokušajte ponovo na otvorenom prostoru.

location_install_gps_required_pay.en: GPS must be enabled to subscribe — pricing is based on your actual location.
location_install_gps_required_pay.hr: Za pretplatu mora biti uključen GPS — cijena se određuje prema vašoj stvarnoj lokaciji.

profile_payment_methods_empty_hint.en: Add PayPal, a card, or a bank account — you can change or remove them anytime.
profile_payment_methods_empty_hint.hr: Dodajte PayPal, karticu ili bankovni račun — možete ih kasnije mijenjati ili ukloniti.

profile_payment_methods_delete_body.en: This payment method will be removed from your profile. You can add it again anytime.
profile_payment_methods_delete_body.hr: Ovaj način plaćanja bit će uklonjen s vašeg profila. Možete ga ponovo dodati kad god želite.

profile_payment_methods_add_paypal_hint.en: Email where you receive PayPal payments
profile_payment_methods_add_paypal_hint.hr: Email na koji primate PayPal uplate

profile_payment_methods_save_card_hint.en: Card is stored masked (last 4 digits only)
profile_payment_methods_save_card_hint.hr: Kartica se sprema maskirano (samo zadnje 4 znamenke)

profile_payment_methods_card_security_hi.en: Full card number and CVC are never stored — only last 4 digits and expiry.
profile_payment_methods_card_security_hi.hr: Puni broj kartice i CVC se ne spremaju — samo zadnje 4 znamenke i datum isteka.

guide_profile_payment_methods_body.en: Manage PayPal, cards, and bank accounts in one place — add, replace, or remove.
guide_profile_payment_methods_body.hr: Ovdje upravljate PayPalom, karticama i bankovnim računom na jednom mjestu — dodajte, zamijenite ili uklonite.

profile_payment_methods_error_title.en: Payment methods could not be loaded

profile_payment_methods_error_permission.en: You do not have permission to access payment methods. Sign in again or wait a few minutes and try again.
profile_payment_methods_error_permission.hr: Nemate dozvolu za pristup načinima plaćanja. Prijavite se ponovo ili pričekajte nekoliko minuta pa pokušajte opet.

profile_payment_methods_error_permission.en: If you are a developer: deploy Firestore rules with firebase deploy --only firestore:rules.
profile_payment_methods_error_permission.hr: Ako ste developer: objavite Firestore pravila naredbom firebase deploy --only firestore:rules.

profile_payment_methods_error_load.en: Something went wrong while loading. Check your connection and try again.
profile_payment_methods_error_load.hr: Došlo je do greške pri učitavanju. Provjerite internet vezu i pokušajte ponovo.

profile_payment_methods_error_offline.en: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
profile_payment_methods_error_offline.hr: Nema veze s poslužiteljem. Provjerite internet i pokušajte ponovo.

profile_payment_methods_error_auth.en: Your session has expired. Sign out and sign in again.
profile_payment_methods_error_auth.hr: Sesija je istekla. Odjavite se i prijavite ponovo.

profile_payment_methods_peer_hint.en: My Farmer does not process payments — enter details for buyers to pay you directly (PayPal, IBAN). The platform is not responsible for payments between users.
profile_payment_methods_peer_hint.hr: My Farmer ne procesira uplate — ovdje unosite podatke na koje vam kupci plaćaju izravno (PayPal, IBAN). Platforma nije odgovorna za plaćanja između korisnika.

peer_payment_disclaimer.en: My Farmer is not a payment intermediary. You arrange and complete payment directly with the seller. The platform does not guarantee, verify, or accept liability for payments, refunds, or disputes.
peer_payment_disclaimer.hr: My Farmer nije platni posrednik. Plaćanje dogovarate i izvršavate izravno s prodavačem. Platforma ne jamči, ne provjerava i ne odgovara za uplate, povrate ili sporove.

peer_payment_disclaimer_short.en: Payment is directly between buyer and seller. My Farmer is not involved in charging.
peer_payment_disclaimer_short.hr: Plaćanje je izravno između kupca i prodavača. My Farmer ne sudjeluje u naplati.

peer_payment_accept_checkbox.en: I understand that My Farmer is not a party to the payment and responsibility is solely between me and the seller.
peer_payment_accept_checkbox.hr: Razumijem da My Farmer nije strana u plaćanju i da je odgovornost isključivo između mene i prodavača.

peer_payment_paypal_instruction.en: Pay the seller directly on PayPal (outside the app):
peer_payment_paypal_instruction.hr: Platite izravno na PayPal prodavača (izvan aplikacije):

peer_payment_bank_instruction.en: Transfer directly to the seller's IBAN:

peer_payment_cash_instruction.en: Pay the seller in cash on pickup or delivery.
peer_payment_cash_instruction.hr: Plaćate gotovinom prodavaču pri preuzimanju ili dostavi.

peer_payment_option_paypal_hint.en: Pay directly to the seller's PayPal email
peer_payment_option_paypal_hint.hr: Uplata izravno na PayPal email prodavača

peer_payment_option_bank_hint.en: Pay directly to the seller's IBAN

peer_payment_upcoming_required.en: Coming-soon products require payment directly to the seller (PayPal or bank), not through the platform.
peer_payment_upcoming_required.hr: Za proizvode u dolasku potrebna je uplata izravno prodavaču (PayPal ili banka), ne preko platforme.

peer_payment_multi_seller.en: For multiple sellers at once, use cash or order from each seller separately.
peer_payment_multi_seller.hr: Za više prodavača odjednom koristite gotovinu ili narudžbu po prodavaču.

peer_payment_seller_missing_title.en: Seller has no payment method set up

peer_payment_seller_missing_paypal.en: The seller has not added PayPal in Payment methods. Choose cash or bank transfer, or contact the seller.
peer_payment_seller_missing_paypal.hr: Prodavač još nije dodao PayPal u Načine plaćanja. Odaberite gotovinu ili bankovni transfer, ili kontaktirajte prodavača.

peer_payment_seller_missing_bank.en: The seller has not added a bank account. Choose PayPal or cash.
peer_payment_seller_missing_bank.hr: Prodavač još nije dodao bankovni račun. Odaberite PayPal ili gotovinu.

peer_payment_order_success_paypal.en: Order sent! Pay the seller directly on PayPal.
peer_payment_order_success_paypal.hr: Narudžba poslata! Platite prodavaču izravno na PayPal.

peer_payment_order_success_bank.en: Order sent! Transfer directly to the seller's IBAN.
peer_payment_order_success_bank.hr: Narudžba poslata! Uplatite prodavaču izravno na IBAN.

product_upcoming_toggle_hint.en: Product will be visible with a countdown until harvest.
product_upcoming_toggle_hint.hr: Proizvod će biti vidljiv s odbrojavanjem do berbe.

product_upcoming_reserve_hint.en: Reserve ahead — harvest is being planned.
product_upcoming_reserve_hint.hr: Rezervišite unaprijed — berba je u tijeku planiranja.

delivery_final_photo_instruction.en: Upload a photo of the actual product in stock to move it to regular sale.
delivery_final_photo_instruction.hr: Učitajte fotografiju stvarnog proizvoda na skladištu kako bi prešao u redovnu prodaju.

product_upcoming_company_toggle_hint.en: Companies can schedule delivery up to {days} days ahead.
product_upcoming_company_toggle_hint.hr: Firma može planirati isporuku do {days} dana unaprijed.

product_upcoming_company_premium_only.en: Coming-soon for companies requires an active Premium subscription.
product_upcoming_company_premium_only.hr: Opcija u dolasku za firme dostupna je samo s aktivnom Premium pretplatom.

product_upcoming_company_max_days.en: Maximum delivery lead time is {days} days.

product_upcoming_farmer_max_days.en: Maximum harvest lead time is {days} days.

product_upcoming_delivery_reserve_hint.en: Reserve ahead — the product is on its way to the warehouse.
product_upcoming_delivery_reserve_hint.hr: Rezervišite unaprijed — roba je na putu prema skladištu.

harvest_update_development_photo.hr: Dodaj novu sliku ploda u razvoju

harvest_complete_confirm_body.en: The product will be hidden until you upload a real photo of the harvested crop.
harvest_complete_confirm_body.hr: Proizvod će biti privremeno skriven dok ne učitate pravu sliku ubranog ploda.

harvest_complete_success.en: Harvest finished — upload the final photo.

harvest_final_photo_alert.en: Please photograph the real harvested product in a crate to move it to regular sale.
harvest_final_photo_alert.hr: Molim te uslikaj pravi, ubrani proizvod u gajbi kako bi prešao u redovnu prodaju.

harvest_final_photo_instruction.en: Upload a photo of the real harvested product in a crate.
harvest_final_photo_instruction.hr: Učitajte fotografiju pravog, ubranog proizvoda u gajbi.

harvest_final_photo_required.en: Select the final photo before publishing.

harvest_final_photo_success.en: Product is now available for purchase!
harvest_final_photo_success.hr: Proizvod je sada dostupan za kupnju!

weather_alert_high_wind.en: Strong wind ({wind} km/h)! Secure greenhouses, nets and tarps before the storm.
weather_alert_high_wind.hr: Jak vjetar ({wind} km/h)! Sigurno učvrstite plastenike, mreže i cerade prije nevremena.

weather_alert_extreme_heat.en: Extreme heat ({temp}°C)! Irrigate early morning and shade sensitive crops.
weather_alert_extreme_heat.hr: Ekstremna vrućina ({temp}°C)! Navodnjavajte u ranim jutarnjim satima i zaklonite osjetljive kulture.

weather_alert_hail.en: Hail risk ({rain}% precipitation)! Cover fruit trees and vegetables; use hail nets if needed.
weather_alert_hail.hr: Rizik od tuče ({rain}% padalina)! Pokrijte voćke i povrće, po potrebi koristite anti-tuš mreže.

weather_alert_frost.en: Frost risk ({temp}°C)! Protect young plants and blossoms with foil or agrotextile.
weather_alert_frost.hr: Rizik od mraza ({temp}°C)! Zaštitite mlade biljke i cvjetove folijom ili agrotekstilom.

weather_alert_storm.en: Thunderstorm alert! Pause field work if needed, secure tarps and protect equipment.
weather_alert_storm.hr: Grmljavina i nepogoda! Po potrebi prekinite rad na polju, učvrstite cerade i zaštitite strojeve.

weather_alert_heavy_rain.en: Heavy rain ({rain}% precipitation)! Check drainage, protect crops and delay spraying.
weather_alert_heavy_rain.hr: Jaka kiša ({rain}% padalina)! Provjerite odvodnju, zaštitite usjeve i odložite prskanje.

guide_add_product_image_body.en: Add a clear photo — buyers see the image first.
guide_add_product_image_body.hr: Dodajte jasnu fotografiju — kupci prvo vide sliku, zatim odlučuju.

guide_add_product_details_body.en: Enter name, description, category, and other product details.
guide_add_product_details_body.hr: Unesite naziv, opis, kategoriju i ostale detalje proizvoda.

guide_add_product_submit_body.en: When everything is ready, publish the product to the marketplace.
guide_add_product_submit_body.hr: Kada je sve spremno, objavite proizvod na tržnicu.

land_nirs_basemap_note.en: The Google Maps satellite background may be older than the NIRS overlay data.
